name: Void's Calling
source:
To be Pure isn't always about having clean hands. If you decided to become a mage's hunter, you'll see all sorts of things, shitty and bloody things. You just can't sit idle knowing that the high art that was prohibited by a royal edict can easily cause disturbance to the world's harmony crafted by the Almighty, and let Void enter our realm, can you?

Lone warriors, led by mysterious Call, who go under the name of The Pure Ones, travel around the continent, always looking for those who have decided to violate the world's harmony with the help of their "wonderful" gift. It doesn't mean a thing whether they're doing it out of selfish motives, simple curiosity, or desire to help everyone.

A man or a woman, all the same. The punishment is inescapable. No mercy for no one! No mercy for no one!

Forlan is only 32, but he's already seen a lot, and it may seem like he's up to anything the world can throw at him. However, at one point, he stumbles upon a small town called Krazengoph while following the call of Void. That place turns out to be a real test of the hunter's abilities since Void has already wormed its way into the citizens' souls and poisons them, with an effect similar to post-mortem poison.

To find a sorcerer who broke the law in the town, whose citizens are slowly but steadily losing their minds and are falling into the cesspool of madness and lust, isn't going to be an easy thing to do. Will the Pure One be able to cope with it alone, or should he look for help from one of the town's citizens? No matter what turn these events might take, there's one thing to be sure of. Forlan will never be the same after visiting this town, Krazengoph... 

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212020/]Steam[/url]]
